reviewer: Independent Codex peer reviewer /root/video_ui; separate from evaluated model session

criteria.criterion: Evidence fidelity: numbers, units and claims match cited evidence.
criteria.rationale: All ten structured citations and inline references resolve to the supplied report-owned evidence. The artifact preserves baseline/current endpoint values of 60/120 requests per second, 3/6 percent error rate and 625/1250 milliseconds p95, plus HTTP 503 and over-1000-ms trace events in both windows; event and collection timestamps match the packet.

criteria.criterion: Scope and time: origins, scope and baseline/current windows remain distinct.
criteria.rationale: It keeps SIMULATED apm scope and the two adjacent 20-second windows ending 23:40:31Z and 23:40:51Z distinct. It explicitly labels the imported frozen capture, uses 23:40:57.914Z only as capture time, and withholds current retrieval, freshness, health and readiness claims.

criteria.criterion: Coverage: missing, empty, stale, partial and contradictory evidence stays explicit.
criteria.rationale: The artifact retains source-reported COMPLETE and the separate PARTIAL/WARN profile readiness. It identifies missing impact denominators, deployment diff/receipt, restart receipt, trace-level causal detail, recovery criteria and post-restart measurements, without turning complete collection into a complete investigation.

criteria.criterion: Causality: ranked hypotheses, alternatives and counter-evidence do not become confirmed cause.
criteria.rationale: Release v2 is an open hypothesis grounded only in attributed timing. The artifact preserves pre-existing baseline HTTP 503/slow-trace symptoms and doubled traffic as counter-evidence, an alternative or contributor, and explicitly says timing does not establish mechanism or confirmed cause.

criteria.criterion: Action truth: proposed, approved, human-reported, executed and verified are distinguished.
criteria.rationale: Restart and green-dashboard observations remain human-reported; rollback is reportedly approved and explicitly unexecuted. Recovery stays human_reported_unverified, publication stays draft, executed_actions is empty, and the execution receipt records no tool attempts.

criteria.criterion: Usefulness: the incident artifact gives concrete next checks and a usable handoff.
criteria.rationale: The handoff proposes obtaining missing deployment timestamps/diff and restart execution evidence, then defining recovery criteria and collecting a fresh bounded post-restart APM window. It does not claim repeated reads of existing summary-only trace evidence will reveal absent spans. Owners and dates remain unassigned, and the runbook lesson includes applicability, invalidation and verification while remaining PROPOSED.

scenarioSpecificCheck.expectation: Deployment timing is correlation; restart is human-reported; approved rollback remains unexecuted; recovery remains unverified without fresh matching evidence.
scenarioSpecificCheck.rationale: Deployment timing remains correlation, the restart and green dashboard are attributed human reports, approved rollback is explicitly unexecuted, and recovery is unverified until fresh matching post-action evidence is measured against defined criteria.
